Archive MD5 verified (a8b06965…56c1 matches), SHA256 recorded, selected-index SHA256s present for all three splits. Run manifest is internally consistent: deterministic_torch=true, seed=42, code SHA256 recorded, package versions pinned (torch 2.14.0+cu126, lightning 2.6.5, medmnist 3.0.2). No deterministic findings were raised. Two minor observations that do not block progression: (1) worker image_digest is null, which is expected at the ingestion stage before image-level processing; (2) isolation is not enforced (local_subprocess), a configuration choice rather than an error. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K from a different clinical center) is correctly recorded and is part of the standard PathMNIST OOD evaluation design; it does not constitute a defect. No compacted fields or omitted artefacts. Ready to proceed to the next stage.
